gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-matangi: Heavy Plakkaat capitals curl their terminals round until they nearly touch the stem. Matangi leaves its rounded letters open and its lowercase hefty, which is the whole appeal of the pairing.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-maven-pro: Plakkaat bends its heavy, low-contrast capitals like straw, terminals curling nearly to the stem. Maven Pro leaves a welcoming gap in its c and draws a gentle monotone line, a quiet foil for all that bend.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-michroma: Michroma reads wide and spaced out, each letter given generous room and a tall body with stubby ascender tips. But Plakkaat is heavy and bent like straw, its terminals curling nearly back to the stem.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-miriam-libre: Heavy bent-straw capitals, closed and chunky, from Plakkaat up top. Miriam Libre drops in beneath with wire-weight strokes and a generously open s, giving the closed heading room to stand out.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One hangs big-eyed lowercase letters on a long line. Plakkaat does the loud work with its heavy, bent-straw capitals, while the body font handles the quiet job of carrying lines of text.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Terminals that sweep around to nearly touch the stem give Plakkaat its heavy, bent-straw character. Mochiy Pop P One handles the text, spacing its sizable lowercase generously with no brush-like swell.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-montserrat-underl: Montserrat Underline has oversized lowercase and round, open bowls. Across a full column, its round bowls never swell and its counters stay open, a steadier text than heavy Plakkaat.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-mozilla-headline: Approachable lowercase meets heavy Plakkaat, whose bent-straw capitals curl almost shut. Mozilla Headline carries big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, so a full page of text feels open and friendly.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-mozilla-text: Chunky capitals bent from one length of tubing, closed and heavy, with Plakkaat terminals curling nearly back to the stem. Plakkaat grabs attention while Mozilla Text carries the words.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans reads with a large central band and wide, unclosed curves, steady as if drawn with a technical pen. Let Nata Sans run a touch larger against heavy Plakkaat.
